sentences.text: The documents do not state a maximum interest rate for UCB on MSE loans.

The bank document says rates of interest on retail loans shall be determined in accordance with the Interest Rate Policy approved by the Board of Directors, but it does not give a maximum rate for MSE loans.

The UCB directions cited here address pre-payment charges for floating rate loans granted for business purpose to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises, and a separate display requirement for microfinance loans, not an MSE interest-rate ceiling.
